decision.question: review size
decision.why: docs plus one read-only report script and one table on an opt-in demo page; no shared code

findings.text: Requirement 3 and 4 are not evidenced in the diff or in task.jsonl (the `owner_note` of kind `decision`, the Figma mastermind's inbox note and its recorded reply); only the long form in round-trip.md exists. Not verifiable from what I was given — the log should show both.

The new token table on the tokens page is 1863px tall at 400 (layout.json band `table`, share 1.86), so it pushes the page's actual demos (schemes, controls) two screens down; 24 rows of three cramped columns, `Relation` text wraps to 3-4 lines (shots/.../400.png, band 5). Put it in a `details`, or give it the page's own tab/section below the demos.

The page shows a table of 24 rows with no picture: for a "show, don't tell" newcomer page, swatches of the Figma vs site colour next to each colour row would make the match obvious (content/design rule: show it with the widget).
round-trip.md is 107 lines against the brief's "one screen"; the four-line answer on top is good, but the 36-row inventory could move to its own doc and be linked (CLAUDE.md law 3).
The 400 wraps list shows the drawer rail buttons wrapping to 3.2 lines (`drawer-rail-ai`, `drawer-rail-menu`); that is existing chrome, not this change.
layout.json at 1200 reports bands with negative `y` (-4510) and ink 0, so the band numbers at 1200+ are not trustworthy; judged from the shot instead.
`await fetch(map.json)` at module top level in page.js: a missing map would break the whole tokens page; fine for a generated committed file, but worth a guard.

Asks 3 and 4 have no evidence: task.jsonl (6 lines) holds no `owner_note` of kind `decision`, no note in the Figma mastermind's inbox and no recorded reply. The long form is in doc/round-trip.md, but the note and the coordination step themselves are missing.

The new token section never comes into view on the desktop shots. 1200, 1920 and 3440 were taken scrolled to the page bottom (layout.json band y is negative, e.g. table y -4150 at 1200), so the table is proven at 400 only. Re-shoot the desktop widths at the top of the page.

Link every mention: the new paragraph on tokens/page.js names "doc/round-trip.md" as plain text, not a link (shots/…/400.png, band 4). The old intro does the same with "doc/token-sync.md", and both should be links.

At 400 the 24-row table takes 1.86 screens (layout.json table share 1.863), and the "Relation" column wraps every row to two lines. It sits inside `details`, but it still renders open in the shot. Shorter relation labels ("same", "renamed", "Figma only") would make each row one line.
round-trip.md says "the controls, layouts and button bar on /framework/ext/Figma/tokens/". That is a link to the page, which is right; the four-line answer reads well and has no jargon.

log.msg: inventory: 36 live Figma pages = 36 rows; 6 coded, 17 doc only, 13 none; tokens 24 vars: 5 same, 2 same-name-other-value, 9 same role, 6 figma-only, 2 skipped. owner_note posted (decision, /framework/ai/2026/10/13/figma-mock-ups-yes-for-looking-no-as-a-s/). Figma inbox/agent: ds-lists-cards said nothing of its pages is coded, wants map + dark + fluid/fixed decision; web-ground said nothing aliases Figma vars yet; sent ds-lists-cards the map link and the dark/fluid ask.

findings.text: The colour swatches and the "All 24 variables" summary that page.js now adds don't appear in the shots: at 400 the `prime` row shows no swatch, though both sides are hex (`#ff6157` / `#FF6157` in map.json), and the table is open with no summary line above it (shots/…tokens/400.png, band 5). Either the shots were taken before the 17:12 fix, or the swatch and `details` code does not render. Re-shoot to prove which.

The new token section is only shown at 400. The 1200, 1920 and 3440 shots are scrolled to the page bottom (layout.json table y -4150 at 1200, ink 0), so the table is never seen at desktop widths (page 1 / layout 1).

At 400 the table is 1.86 screens tall (layout.json table share 1.863), and every "Relation" cell wraps to two lines. Shorter labels ("same", "role", "Figma only"), with the note in a `title` tooltip, would halve it (wrapping 1).

The inline links "doc/token-sync.md" and "doc/round-trip.md" are now markdown links in page.js. In the 400 shot they are the same colour as body text, so they don't look like links (content: link every mention).
round-trip.md's first line says "the Figma file has many pages", while the computed count right below says 36. Say "36 pages, 6 coded" in the headline (words 1).
The `drawer-rail-ai` and `drawer-rail-menu` wraps at 400 (3.2 lines) are existing chrome, not this change.

answer.reply: fixed: owner_note posted, Figma agent messaged, both logged in task.jsonl
fixed: fresh headless shot of the table open at 1920, shots/tokens-table-1920.png: 13 swatches, 25 rows, summary present
fixed: the shots predate the fix; the summary and swatches render (DOM check + shot)
declined: the Relation text carries the reason, which is the point; table is collapsed behind a summary
declined: link colour is the page's shared style, not this change
